content.text: New Operator Orientation — Hydraulic Power Unit Basics
Training Excerpt — Slides 4–6 of the full deck

The Hydraulic Power Unit is the heart of the press's hydraulic system.
You'll sometimes hear techs call it the "hydraulic pack" or just "the unit" — same thing.
It pulls fluid from the main reservoir and, on most Line 4/5 configurations, tops up from a smaller Auxiliary Reservoir during peak demand.
Discharge pressure is what the controller watches to decide if the unit is running normally.
Note: “Auxiliary Reservoir” is a Line 4/5-specific configuration detail and is not covered in the standard Operator Manual.
These four checks match the startup interlocks shown on the HOME screen of the HMI.
Full startup and shutdown procedures are in the Operator Manual (AEG-OM-700) — this slide is a quick memory aid only, not a replacement procedure.
